Exhumed: Unearthing the History of the American Vampire

By Aaron Mahnke

Exhumed is a New York Times bestseller.

Exhumed is a debut work of narrative nonfiction.

Winner of the 2026 Baillie Gifford Prize, Exhumed reframes a nineteenth century panic.

Exhumed is published with the backing of the Lore Foundation.

The book follows the New England Vampire Panic of the 1890s through folklore, early medicine and the newspapers that carried the story across the region.
